title: Creative writing
learning_outcomes: Explain character and scene in the context of creative writing.
Compare and distinguish narrative voice in the context of creative writing.
Apply imagery and dialogue in the context of creative writing.
Evaluate and justify decisions about editing in the context of creative writing.

lessons.title: Character and scene
lessons.outcome: Explain character and scene in the context of creative writing.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving character and scene; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to original story or essay.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain character and scene from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of character and scene; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Narrative voice
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish narrative voice in the context of creative writing.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving narrative voice; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to original story or essay.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain narrative voice from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of narrative voice; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Imagery and dialogue
lessons.outcome: Apply imagery and dialogue in the context of creative writing.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving imagery and dialogue; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to original story or essay.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain imagery and dialogue from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of imagery and dialogue; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Editing
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about editing in the context of creative writing.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving editing; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to original story or essay.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain editing from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of editing; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of character and scene; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of narrative voice; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of imagery and dialogue; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of editing; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Practising artist or arts educator; cultural expertise where relevant.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
